channel.title: Video Communities Revisited — stories
channel.description: Video Communities Revisited is a research project on the role of physical screen media — VHS, Betamax, DVD, rental shops, collectors, swap meets and boutique labels — in forming communities in Britain, past and present.

item.title: Why video shops matter
item.description: A short argument for taking the rental shop seriously: not as nostalgia, but as a piece of social infrastructure.

item.title: Field notes from a swap meet
item.description: Notes from a morning among folding tables, a thousand tapes and one very patient man with a splicing machine.

item.title: Reading the label
item.description: A tape is an object before it is a recording. What the label, the case and the handwriting can tell us.
